Thus encouraged, Torres continued.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“I am his friend, his very good best friend. You, who know all things, know the custom of the marriage dowry. You must know that he is among the richest of men in his own country, where men are very rich.”", "sha256": "a01d5423e321a28c8a6fb2666cabbc9243b94b8f361c0b4ede88a8cc0a21a1af", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1795]", "source_html": "

So suddenly did she arise on the divan that Torres cringed and half shrank down, in his panic expectance of a knife-blade between his shoulders. Instead, the Queen walked swiftly, or, rather, glided, to the doorway to an inner apartment.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Come!” she summoned imperiously.", "sha256": "5ac92b487653f3fd4f3f2d24d0b189e489161a6f15e70d07e01ab579b1523bbe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1797]", "source_html": "

“Come!” she summoned imperiously.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "Once inside, at the first glance around, Torres knew the room for what it was, her sleeping chamber. But his eyes had little space for such details. Lifting the lid of a heavy chest of ironwood, brass-bound, she motioned him to look in. He obeyed, and saw the amazement of the world. The little maid had spoken true. Like so much shelled corn, the chest was filled with an incalculable treasure of gems——diamonds, rubies, emeralds, sapphires, the most precious, the purest and largest of their kinds.", "sha256": "403dd2b9b666a5a2d9afaaca2a109f5ff567d52622dd8b2ff7afdffdd48e13cc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1798]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“Thrust in your arms to the shoulders,” she said, “and make sure that these baubles be real and of the adamant of flint, rather than illusions and reflections of unreality dreamed real in a dream. Thus may you make certain report to your very rich friend who is to marry me.”", "sha256": "9d2f2f4031eb6e0f5e4e9c802d32cf12955f256c3d0b73a8642c5a194248654a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1799]", "source_html": "

“Thrust in your arms to the shoulders,” she said, “and make sure that these baubles be real and of the adamant of flint, rather than illusions and reflections of unreality dreamed real in a dream. Thus may you make certain report to your very rich friend who is to marry me.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0038", "tag": "p", "text": "And Torres, the madness of the ancient drink like fire in his brain, did as he was told.", "sha256": "14119889e388d351f1a89cfd27cfedcdaee27fa14f9385f941ae25bd1b30a76e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1800]", "source_html": "

And Torres, the madness of the ancient drink like fire in his brain, did as he was told.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“These trifles of glass are such an astonishment?” she plagued. “Your eyes are as if they were witnessing great wonders.”", "sha256": "43bc8ba65f3859b6416b64c8c317bf9ae970f4461012a96b40214ea220cb0d50", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1801]", "source_html": "

“These trifles of glass are such an astonishment?” she plagued. “Your eyes are as if they were witnessing great wonders.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0040", "tag": "p", "text": "“I never dreamed in all the world there was such a treasure,” he muttered in his drunkenness.", "sha256": "dbb805415da9c6978e0b4b2f77cc71f6ab89a68d9d92328f927f391c0c7a0656", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1802]", "source_html": "

“I never dreamed in all the world there was such a treasure,” he muttered in his drunkenness.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0041", "tag": "p", "text": "“They are beyond price?”", "sha256": "c8b14bd94a48f6c34c4dee8c238bb9f4f4b2a565f5515a77effc94aefc73c254", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1803]", "source_html": "

“They are beyond price?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0042", "tag": "p", "text": "“They are beyond price.”", "sha256": "c60b4cde10f478f8ff723e2aa1a35556f165aeaa7f125a68a578f6bb9940e10b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1804]", "source_html": "

“They are beyond price.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0043", "tag": "p", "text": "“They are beyond the value of valor, and love, and honor?”", "sha256": "63a084f8fec8e4555289192c257f44e8bd0164f66338b246fad6df7d655e60aa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1805]", "source_html": "

“They are beyond the value of valor, and love, and honor?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0044", "tag": "p", "text": "“They are beyond all things. They are a madness.”", "sha256": "40fee39de9d976270b15c65bc2aefc413fdc04692548b8535c16b36ad36c55f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1806]", "source_html": "

“They are beyond all things. They are a madness.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0045", "tag": "p", "text": "“Can a woman’s or a man’s true love be purchased by them?”", "sha256": "049201b18ef949383b4e92fdbc9f79b323531db0293dab982201af15a61b3e9e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1807]", "source_html": "

“Can a woman’s or a man’s true love be purchased by them?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0046", "tag": "p", "text": "“They can purchase all the world.”", "sha256": "29bad535719d22e954a4ae3cb7165e21fc98e3974544038d4ee4172d665ff54d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1808]", "source_html": "

“They can purchase all the world.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u021-r0047", "tag": "p", "text": "“Come,” the Queen said. “You are a man. You have held women in your arms. Will they purchase women?”", "sha256": "f7cae6f4581a0b35f5ee5227cf34f543270eab1e75eb72bbc735cafed38a8853", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1809]", "source_html": "

“Come,” the Queen said. “You are a man. You have held women in your arms. Will they purchase women?”
